jobs_results.title: Big Data Developer
jobs_results.description:
Our opportunity

We are seeking a Data Engineer to join our DBI organization within Data Engineering team.

We are looking for a proactive person who is eager to learn new technologies, bring knowledge and experience to the team, and who likes to apply good practices in the work they do, given that we are the reference in this aspect for the rest of the organisation.

The profile must have experience in the implementation, integration and industrialisation of Python code, with special emphasis on the industrialisation of solutions developed by our Data Scientist team, so knowledge in ML and data modelling with Databricks and other technologies will be important.

Your role

As a Data Engineer, your main responsibilities will involve:
• Analyze data models and derive logical conclusions.
• Processes modeling.
• Hands on development and monitoring of the Azure cloud Platform and various associated components for data ingestion, transformation and processing.
• Effectively diagnose... isolate, and resolve complex problems pertaining to data infrastructure, including performance tuning and optimization.
• Designs and writes programs according to functional and non-functional requirements.
• Develops and maintains technical documentation.
• Follows established configur ation/change control processes.

Your Skills And Experience

As a Data Engineer, your skills and experience will ideally include:
• University level education or equivalent
• 2+ years of experience working as a Data Engineer
• Knowledge of design patterns
• Ability to write complex SQL queries
• A good understanding of distributed computation
• GIT
• Experience with Azure cloud.
• Experience with Databricks.
• 5+ years Python
• 1+ years of experience in Apache Spark 2.0
• 2+ years of experience working as a Software Engineer
• Experience with containerization of solutions (Docker, Kubernetes).

Nice to have:
• DBT
• Experience with Python Poetry framework
• 1+ Experience in functional programming (preferably Scala - big plus)
• Experience in R programming
• Experience with Hadoop technologies (i.e. Sqoop, Hive, Flume etc.)
• Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment (Azure DevOps)
• Experience in data exploration using notebooks (Databricks notebooks).
• Experience with experiment tracking and model registry (MLflow).
• Understanding of how to deploy, operationalize, and monitor ML models.
• Experience with Python libraries like pandas, numpy, and scikit-learn.
• Experience in automation of regular tasks(e.g. data refreshes) using bash and python scripting.

What we offer?

As well as a competitive salary and a yearly bonus we offer:
• Option to work remotely up to 100% of the time.
• 300 euros net to set up your home office and additional monthly home office allowance.
• Wide range of internal and external trainings, including free English, German and Spanish classes depending on the needs
• Ticket restaurant or flexibility to exchange it for other benefits.
• Life, accident, and Health Insurance
• Collective Life Retirement Plan
• 2000 referral bonus if you bring other talented people like you.
• Special banking and insurance conditions plus Exclusive Employees discounts
• Functional diversity benefits
• Events : summer and Christmas party, different activities like hiking, investment, beach volley club and many more
• No dress code.

Primary work location is Barcelona, Poblenou. Please apply with your CV in English.

Who We Are

Looking for a challenging and inspiring work environment where you can make a difference? At Zurich millions of individuals and businesses place their trust in our products and services every day. Our 53,000 employees worldwide form the basis of our success, enabling, businesses and communities to face a world of risk with confidence. Imagine if you could help people do this all over the world. You’d give them confidence and reassurance by protecting what they love most. It’s a big challenge, but you will be supported by a world-class team who believe in helping you to reach your full potential and deliver on our promises.

Diversity & Inclusion

At Zurich we are an equal opportunity employer. We attract and retain the best qualified individuals available, without regard to race/ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age or disability.

So be challenged. Be inspired. Help us make a difference .

Por qué elegir Zurich

En Zurich, nos gusta pensar con originalidad y desafiar el statu quo. Adoptamos un enfoque optimista centrándonos en los aspectos positivos y preguntándonos constantemente ¿Qué puede salir bien?

Somos un empleador que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades y que sabe que cada colaborador es único ¡lo que hace que nuestro equipo sea el mejor!

Colabora con nosotros mientras exploramos constantemente nuevas formas de proteger a nuestros clientes y al planeta .

Nueva requisición de puesto creada: ES - Barcelona

Trabajo remoto: Yes

Programar : a tiempo completo

Nombre del reclutador: Alvaro Gallego Zazo

Fecha de cierre

MCA is a European engineering and technology consulting company,

which has 1450 employees and 110 million euros in sales.

Thanks to our 30 years of experience, we accompany our large customers in their efforts to

accounts in the realization of their projects.

Would you like to join a growing company that will give you all the information you need?

the keys to develop your career? Apply now!

Your missions

MCA Spain is a company specialized in Software and IT, and we work on cutting-edge projects for clients in sectors such as Life Science, Aeronautics, Energy, Mobility, Banking, Insurance, Telcos...

MCA Engineering is based in France, but we have offices in other parts of the world: Sweden, Belgium, The Netherlands, Germany, Italy, China... We are growing fast in Spain (Madrid and Barcelona) and right now we need to expand our Data Engineering team.

Your Profile
• A person with a desire to further develop his career as a Data Engineer and with at least 1 year of experience... using different languages and technologies:
• That you have worked at least 1 year with SPARK, developing with Scala / Python / Java in Data projects.
• ETLs
• Experience with relational databases, particularly MySQL.
• Familiarity with Cloud environments (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).
• Experience with Hadoop, Hive technologies also highly valued!
• Someone who is eager to keep learning and adapts well to change.
• You like to work in a team.
• You have a passion for data and technology.
• You have a Degree / Career / Bachelor's Degree in Computer Engineering / Computer / Software...
• Spanish (Native level).
• English (B2).
• Any other language is welcome.

We offer
• Permanent contract with us.
• Personalized career plan, mark your own path.
• Financial assistance for training.
• Full medical insurance.
• Surround yourself with the BEST team of professionals in the sector.
• Flexibility
• Great working environment ;)
• Come to MCA Spain and take your career to the next level !
• *Confidentiality is guaranteed throughout the entire hiring process

jobs_results.title: BIG DATA ENGINEER (REMOTO)
jobs_results.description:
Desde onhunters estamos buscando BIG DATA ENGINEER para trabajar en importante compañía internacional, en Madrid.

Las Funciones a Realizar Serán
• Optimización de modelos de datos en stack de Cloudera: Impala, Spark, ETL en Hive, HDFS
• Migración de datos y analítica avanzada a Cloudera.
• Integración de flujos y orquestación de procesos.
• Conocimientos en Cloudera Data Platform (CDP)
• Entorno Tecnológíco: Apache Hadoop, HDFS, Apache Hbase, Apache Spark, Apache Hive, Apache Impala, Apache Nifi, Apache Kudu

Requisitos

Mínimos:
• Titulación universitaria o similar equiparable.

Experiencia De Al Menos 3 Años En
• Proyectos de datos desarrollados bajo el ecosistema Cloudera ,Azure o equivalente.
• Procesamiento de grandes volúmenes de información con Spark o equivalente.
• Trabajando en HDFS, BD SQL y NoSQL (MongoDB, Elastic o equivalentes).
• Lenguajes de programación: Python y/o Scala.
• Modelado de datos.
• Herramientas de control de versiones como Git y Gitlab, y en repositorios... de código como Artifactory o similar.
• Herramientas de ecosistema de Apache Hadoop: Apache NIFI, Sqoop, Kafka, Apache Kudu, Apache Spark, ApacheOozie, Apache Airflow, ApacheHIVE, Apache Atlas, Apache KNOX, Apache Impala, Apache Hbase o Arcadia Data

jobs_results.title: Big Data Developer
jobs_results.description:
Job Spec/Qualifications:
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
• Proven at least 5 years of working experience as a Big Data Engineer, preferably working with Cloudera and Spark technologies.
• Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Scala, Python, or Java.
• Strong knowledge of API architectures preferably developed with Spring Boot.
• In-depth knowledge of distributed computing principles and frameworks, including Hadoop and Spark.
• Hands-on experience with Cloudera distribution and related tools like HDFS, Hive, Impala, and HBase.
• Proficiency in designing, implementing, and optimizing data pipelines using Spark Streaming, Spark SQL, or other Spark modules.
• Expertise in data modeling and database design principles, including schema design, partitioning, and indexing.
• Familiarity with data ingestion techniques and tools, such as Kafka, Flume, Sqoop, or Nifi.
• Strong understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, data... warehousing concepts, and ETL processes.
• Experience with cloud platforms like AWS or Azure, and knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes is a plus.
• Understanding of data governance, data privacy, and security practices, particularly in an international context.
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize data processing workflows.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in an international team setting.
• Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver high-quality results within defined timelines.
• Continuous learning mindset to stay updated with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in big data engineering.
• The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and take on new responsibilities quickly

jobs_results.description:
Job Spec/Qualifications:

• Proven at least 5 years of working experience as a Big Data Engineer, preferably working with Cloudera and Spark technologies.
• Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Scala, Python, or Java.
• Strong knowledge of API architectures preferably developed with Spring Boot.
• In-depth knowledge of distributed computing principles and frameworks, including Hadoop and Spark.
• Hands-on experience with Cloudera distribution and related tools like HDFS, Hive, Impala, and HBase.

• Expertise in data modeling and database design principles, including schema design, partitioning, and indexing.
• Familiarity with data ingestion techniques and tools, such as Kafka, Flume, Sqoop, or Nifi.
• Strong understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, data... warehousing concepts, and ETL processes.
• Experience with cloud platforms like AWS or Azure, and knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes is a plus.
• Understanding of data governance, data privacy, and security practices, particularly in an international context.
• Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to troubleshoot and optimize data processing workflows.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in an international team setting.
• Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and deliver high-quality results within defined timelines.
• Continuous learning mindset to stay updated with emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices in big data engineering.
• The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and take on new responsibilities quickly.

Duties / Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain scalable and efficient data processing pipelines using Cloudera and Spark technologies among others to handle large volumes of data from diverse sources.
• Design and implement data ingestion, transformation, and storage processes to ensure data quality, integrity, and availability across international locations.
• Develop and maintain scalable API solutions to provide data to both: external and internal customers.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical specifications for data processing and analysis.
• Optimize data workflows and performance of Spark jobs to meet strict latency and throughput requirements in processing massive datasets.
• Implement data governance practices and ensure compliance with data privacy and security regulations across different regions.
• Conduct troubleshooting and performance tuning of the Cloud or On-premises infrastructure to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and optimize resource utilization.
• Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to provide timely and reliable data sets for advanced analytics and machine learning models.
• Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends related to big data processing, Cloudera, and Spark, and propose innovative solutions to enhance data processing capabilities.
• Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to junior members of the team, fostering a collaborative and learning culture within the international team.
• Participate in agile development practices, including sprint planning, code reviews, and continuous integration and deployment, to ensure high-quality software delivery
